verdict.rationale: Community reports show TeamViewer clients on macOS (a controlling app installed to control another desktop) and on Windows, which gives thin direct evidence of multi-platform desktop clients. Nothing documents a platform support matrix, native mobile viewer or host apps, or sessions between different operating systems. The Mobile SDK add-on is a developer building block and the mobile device management feature is adjacent, so neither counts toward this story. missing for 10: a first-party list of supported platforms, evidence of iOS/Android viewer and host clients, explicit documentation of cross-OS host/viewer sessions, Linux coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of a cross-OS connection.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems

citations.quote: Mac complaint: TeamViewer can't be installed without admin permissions even if you only want to control another desktop.
One user runs TeamViewer on a single PC only to log into Windows and start Steam
